reviewedBy: lane B, 26 Sep 2026: CCC Application for Special Licence (8 pages)

items.text: Lodged at least 20 working days before the event
items.sourceQuote: Applications must be lodged with the Agency at least 20 working days before the licence is required (event date).

items.text: If lodged late, includes a letter explaining the reason for lateness
items.sourceQuote: Short notice applications (less than 20 working days before the event date) must be accompanied by a letter explaining the reason for lateness for DLC consideration.

items.text: Allows for the 20 December to 15 January non-working period
items.sourceQuote: There is a statutory non-working day period every year from 20 December to 15 January.

items.text: States expected attendance per event and number of events so the fee class can be set
items.sourceQuote: How many people do you expect to be attending each event?

items.text: Names a manager for the event, or asks for the section 213(1) exemption
items.sourceQuote: Do you wish to be exempt from the requirement of section 213(1) to appoint at least one manager?

items.text: Describes a genuine event and its purpose, not extra trading hours
items.sourceQuote: applications will not be accepted for what appears to be a request for additional hours for “Continuation of trade” rather than a genuine “event”

items.text: Lists the areas to be licensed and any restricted or supervised designation
items.sourceQuote: Please list the areas of the premises to be used (including for any outside areas), and any designations sought:

items.text: States the days and hours alcohol will be sold or supplied
items.sourceQuote: On which days and during which hours does the applicant intend to sell or supply alcohol at the event?

items.text: Describes the food available and who provides it
items.sourceQuote: being a good host, and normal practice now dictates, that food is continuously available

items.text: Lists low-alcohol and non-alcoholic drinks
items.sourceQuote: Non-alcoholic refreshments:

items.text: Describes help with alternative transport
items.sourceQuote: What steps does the applicant propose to take to provide assistance with or information about alternative forms of transport from the licensed premises?

items.text: Explains how minors, intoxicated people and uninvited people will not be served
items.sourceQuote: Prohibited persons are minors, intoxicated persons, persons not attending/invited to the event/ occasion/gathering

items.text: Explains how drinking water is freely available
items.sourceQuote: To what extent, where, and how is drinking water intended to be freely available to patrons?

items.text: Describes staff, systems and training for compliance
items.sourceQuote: What appropriate staff, systems and training will be in place to ensure compliance with the law?

items.text: Explains how noise will be managed
items.sourceQuote: How will noise be managed and mitigated?

items.text: Explains how disorderly behaviour, nuisance and vandalism will be prevented
items.sourceQuote: How will you ensure there is no disorderly behaviour/general nuisance or increase in vandalism caused by your event or by persons attracted to your event?

items.text: Attaches a site plan of the area to be licensed
items.sourceQuote: A plan of the building/detailed site plan of the area to be licensed

items.text: Attaches confirmation of other consents (building, traffic management, lease of public space)
items.sourceQuote: Confirmation of any other required consents/approvals granted or have been applied for: Building, Traffic Management; lease of public space.

items.text: Attaches an Alcohol Management Plan if more than 150 guests are expected
items.sourceQuote: Alcohol Management Plan if the number of expected guests exceeds 150

items.text: Attaches food and drinks menus
items.sourceQuote: Drinks / Beverage Menus
